what: What the repair (arm J5R, step 19) stored per fit. Written after the gate failed; no new run.
per_fit_file: <folder>/fits.npz (untracked cache; one row per MC fit, in the order made)

columns.start: -1 for the fit from the voxel's own end, else the candidate voxel whose snapshot orientation was the start (int32)
columns.cost: strict cost of the end (final overlap evaluation)
columns.evals: evaluations of the whole fit, final overlap evaluation included (Reconstructor.last_local_optimization_evals)

also.repair_json: <folder>/repair.json: counts, changed voxels, wall (contended), median evaluations per fit

trace_note: No per-evaluation trace and no per-gain trace of any MC fit is stored: only the end and the total evaluations of each fit. A later step that wants to replay a cheaper stop on these fits would have to re-run them, with one generator default_rng(0) over the voxels in index order (a fit's draws depend on every earlier fit, so a replay must keep that order).
not_stored: the list of flagged voxels (it is recomputed by repair_rules from the stored pass tries; flags.json holds only the counts) and the candidates per voxel
